hypothesis.claim: A no-train auxiliary recurrence that shares the current parent ByteMixer parameters but advances one of 4,096 hidden/cell states along causal template-field subsequences will recover at least 50,000 exact net archive bytes on canonical opening 10M, remain positive in every third, and beat global, shifted, ordinal-random, and complemented recurrent controls.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire the exact WIKI-LOOM realization without a slot, warmth, key, width, route, or mixture sweep if P/K identity, any inverse, repeat, causality, dependency, or resource gate fails; if M saves fewer than 50,000 net bytes; if any chronological third is nonpositive; or if D fails a 10,000-byte-equivalent margin over any matched control.

changedMechanism: Add semantic virtual time as a new state coordinate: preserve original byte order and all parent state while routing one shared-weight auxiliary recurrent hidden/cell trajectory through decoder-visible template-field fibers.
invariants: The authoritative q1 parent passes its artifact-derived v2 qualification before source materialization or execution.
The opening population is exactly the first 10,000,000 canonical raw enwik9 bytes with the objective-bound corpus hash.
Every route descriptor is complete and decoder-visible before the first predicted byte in that field value.
The state bank has exactly 4,096 direct-mapped slots, 64-bit fingerprints, and a fixed 128-prior-byte field-entry warmth rule.
A miss sleeps for the entire current field, installs only after the field-entry decision, and cannot become awake from current-field truths.
The auxiliary recurrence reads current parent ByteMixer parameters but writes no parent weight, optimizer, gradient, deferred-update, recurrent, mixer, SSE, context, coder, or preprocessing state.
P and K execute identical ordinary parent updates at identical source call sites and cadence.
D, G, S, R, and N share the same eligible byte positions, state geometry, parent parameter view, no-train transition, byte conditionalization, and update ordering.
M uses one global gamma_safe_mix_v1 posterior, updates only after awake truth bits, and neither updates nor resets while asleep.
No page reorder, copy source, copy length, occurrence selector, route identifier, field length, model weight, or corpus-fitted table is transmitted.
The compressed incremental source, framing, package, resource, and exact inverse are charged before promotion.
